spoken_summary: The speaker describes Sheridan Gorman as a young woman in Chicago who was shot and killed while walking with friends near her university, allegedly by "a legal alien from Venezuela who had no right to be here." She calls it "despicable" that Democrats are "defunding the department responsible for removing illegal aliens." She then holds up a printed survey of media coverage, citing that ABC News devoted 1 minute 19 seconds, CBS 2 minutes 1 second, and NBC only 23 seconds to Gorman's case — framing this as inadequate coverage of "a young, beautiful American woman whose life was taken short by an illegal alien." She links the coverage disparity to an ongoing Capitol Hill fight over funding for the immigration enforcement agency. Key quote: "It's despicable that the lack of coverage of this young woman's case, of her life, and the way that it was tragically cut short."
